claim_ceiling: Reproduction and extension of a trajectory-based interaction-geometry inference task; no claim of biological intelligence, agency, or general life detection

publication.title: A correlation based framework for inferring interaction geometry in collective motion
publication.primary_finding: IGIC uses lagged circular correlations between neighbour-averaged headings and subsequent individual motion across candidate interaction geometries; it reports 99.2% overall geometry-recovery accuracy on its synthetic visual-Vicsek validation data.

source_dataset.title: A correlation based framework for inferring interaction geometry in collective motion (data and code)
source_dataset.software_license_status: VERIFY_PER_FILE_METADATA; dataset-level CC BY metadata is not automatically a software package licence
source_dataset.admission_note: The source dataset page identifies a CC BY 4.0 licence and describes the contents, but the file inventory and per-file hashes have not yet been acquired in this branch.

method_summary.name: Interaction Geometry Inference using Correlation (IGIC)
method_summary.estimator: Lagged circular correlation between neighbour-averaged headings and subsequent focal-agent motion, evaluated across candidate interaction geometries.
method_summary.synthetic_visual_vicsek_claim: 99.2% overall recovery accuracy across a broad range of sensing angles and noise intensities, as reported by the authors.
method_summary.topological_vicsek_claim: Evaluated under deliberate model mismatch where no true metric interaction radius exists; the method estimates an effective interaction scale imposed by the topological neighbourhood.
method_summary.empirical_claim: Applied to Golden Shiner trajectories; inferred radius and sensing-angle estimates were reported as consistent with independently reported visual range and blind zones; robustness to temporal lag was assessed.

task_definition.source_faithful_reproduction: Reproduce the paper's exact synthetic visual Vicsek conditions, candidate geometry grid, lag range, trajectory selection, preprocessing, score calculation and reported 99.2% metric.

baselines: lagged circular correlation with the same candidate geometry grid
transfer entropy baseline from source paper
mutual information baseline from source paper
interventional adjacency oracle on synthetic systems

evaluation_protocol.source_split: Recover and preserve exact splits/seeds from the source code; do not invent a nominally equivalent split and call it reproduction.
evaluation_protocol.anti_leakage: All frames from the same simulated trajectory remain in one split. Frames, overlapping windows and time lags from one run are not independent test systems.
holdouts: irregular sampling and missing trajectory segments
evaluation_protocol.empirical_data: Keep Golden Shiner trajectories as an independent empirical evaluation stratum; do not mix them into synthetic train/test partitions.

oli_extensions.question: Does the inferred metric radius remain calibrated when the true interaction rule is topological and no unique physical radius exists?
oli_extensions.expected_behavior: Return an effective-scale estimate with explicit model-mismatch status, not a falsely precise physical radius.

oli_extensions.question: Can a trajectory-only estimator distinguish direct interaction from shared exogenous drive?
oli_extensions.expected_behavior: Statistical dependence may remain, but causal-edge attribution must abstain or be rejected without intervention evidence.

oli_extensions.question: Can an asymmetric interaction network be recovered when A influences B but B does not influence A?
oli_extensions.expected_behavior: Direction and edge strength are separately estimated and calibrated.

oli_extensions.question: How does irregular sampling or observation cadence slower than the interaction response affect recovered geometry?
oli_extensions.expected_behavior: Report degraded power and explicit temporal-aliasing risk; do not silently interpret the wrong lag as a different mechanism.

oli_extensions.question: Do controlled single-agent perturbations confirm the geometry inferred from observational trajectories?
oli_extensions.expected_behavior: Compare intervention-derived response graph against the IGIC/correlation graph and quantify disagreements.
